title: Rain in Your Madeira Forecast: When Should You Book the Boat Trip?
description: Book early in your stay, for the calmest sea, not the driest sky. A rain icon over Funchal often means mountain showers. Free cancellation ends at 24 hours.
heroAlt: The boat on sunlit water off Funchal while grey rain clouds sit on the mountains behind
keywords: rain in madeira forecast boat trip
when to book a boat trip in madeira
does it rain in funchal when the forecast says rain

images.prompt: Realistic drone photograph from about 50 metres above the sea off Praia Formosa, just west of Funchal, late morning. A white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy crosses sunlit deep blue water with a short white wake. Behind it the city and the green slopes of São Martinho are in sunshine, while a thick dark grey cloud bank sits on the mountain tops above and a faint rainbow arcs over the hills. True colours, small figures on deck, no faces, no text.
images.alt: The boat on sunlit water off Funchal while grey rain clouds sit on the mountains behind

images.prompt: From under the dark canopy of a white motor boat with grey cushioned seats, looking out at a short shower falling on calm grey-blue sea off Câmara de Lobos, a band of sunlight already breaking through on the water further west, a few raindrops on the edge of the canopy, no people.
images.alt: A passing shower on the sea off Câmara de Lobos seen from under the boat canopy

images.prompt: Evening view from the sea west of Funchal towards the horizon: the sun low and partly hidden behind a long bank of cloud, golden light leaking out under the cloud onto a calm sea, the dark outline of the coast near Cabo Girão to the right, no boats, no people.
images.alt: A cloud bank hiding part of the sunset over the sea west of Funchal
